verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a first-party disputes page saying it "will facilitate your dispute management step-by-step," which shows a documented dispute-handling flow. The pack does not show how evidence is submitted or how a dispute's status is tracked through to resolution. missing for 10: documented structured evidence submission (fields, file uploads, API or dashboard flow), dispute lifecycle states and status tracking, dispute-specific notifications or events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
